items.title: Jamey Aebersold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 26, 2022
items.q: Dave Brubeck comped on my Dave Brubeck play-a-long. And afterwards he said, “Jamey, that’s the hardest thing I’ve ever had to do.”

ctx.x: In the early stages I don’t think it was because we all, none of us really knew what we were doing. We were trying to lay down some tracks and I probably told the piano player don’t play too busy. And drummer, don’t take a solo, delineate the form, eight bar

phrases, four bar phrases, whatever. And bass player, just walk. You know? And I don’t even think we did any bossa novas on the very, very first one. I doubt it. They were probably all kind of swing. But later, once we moved in and you had people like Hal Galper who you’ve interviewed, and some other ones, they found — Ronnie Mathews on the piano up in New York. They found it a little difficult to just comp. Dave Brubeck comped on my Dave Brubeck play-a-long. And afterwards he said, “Jamey, that’s the hardest…
I can hear him say that.
